text_block_list.text:
All the runners put their hearts and souls
into the
Arima Kinen, but it's Grass
Wonder who
ultimately stands alone at
the top.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик is in tears, having trained
so hard
only to come up short.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер thanks her for giving it
everything
she had and praises her
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер has reached a new
plateau.
However, her journey is far from
over.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
